section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive and correlational analyses results from a study examining relationships between multiple variables. BMI showed negative associations with body appreciation (BAS-2) and early memories of warmth/safeness, with moderate effect sizes, while positive associations were found between early memories of warmth/safeness and body appreciation. A partial correlation analysis controlling for age confirmed that the direction and magnitude of correlations remained consistent.
